creatures.lore_description: The oldest thing in the Whispering Trenches.
Grey sea dogs that hunt the shallows by scent.
Brass legs, a ticking heart and a shell that turns blades.
A stone guard who wakes when the watchtower is disturbed.
A tangle of weed with a grip like rope.
Its light draws the curious close enough to bite.
A flicker in Whisperwood that bites cold.
The echo of a drowned watchman, still walking his round between the hours.

steps.text: Find the Pearl Grotto inside the Drowned Caves
Swim to the Pelagoria Sea Gate
Read the Forgemaster's Tablet in the Archive of Tides
Salvage key metal from the Sunken Schooner
Forge the Anchor Spellstone in the Forge of Whispers
Take control of the Royal Depths
Wait at the Heart of the Deep for the Drowned Bell Clock to chime
Learn the clockwork recipe from Pelagoria before the flood

spellstones.name: Anchor Spellstone
spellstones.power: Roots you in place so you can't be knocked down

spellstones.name: Beacon Spellstone
spellstones.power: Marks your spot so companions and the rescuer come first

spellstones.name: Bell Spellstone
spellstones.power: Rings an alarm that scatters nearby rivals

spellstones.name: Burrow Spellstone
spellstones.power: Digs a tunnel through earth or rock

spellstones.name: Cipher Spellstone
spellstones.power: Reads any code or old writing

spellstones.name: Clockwork Spellstone
spellstones.power: Builds a small clockwork helper

spellstones.name: Compass Spellstone
spellstones.power: Points to the nearest unclaimed spellstone

spellstones.name: Ember Spellstone
spellstones.power: Shows the glowing footprints of anyone who passed in the last hour

spellstones.name: Fog Spellstone
spellstones.power: Fills an area with fog for sneaking

spellstones.name: Frost Spellstone
spellstones.power: Freezes water into bridges

spellstones.name: Gale Spellstone
spellstones.power: A gust of wind that knocks enemies back

spellstones.name: Glass Spellstone
spellstones.power: Makes walls see-through for a minute

spellstones.name: Hush Spellstone
spellstones.power: Silences an area so rivals can't hear you

spellstones.name: Lantern Spellstone
spellstones.power: Reveals hidden doors and sealed locks

spellstones.name: Ledger Spellstone
spellstones.power: Shows everyone who has held an object

spellstones.name: Lure Spellstone
spellstones.power: Makes a fake noise that pulls rivals away

spellstones.name: Magnet Spellstone
spellstones.power: Pulls metal things to you, even a spellstone a rival dropped

spellstones.name: Map Spellstone
spellstones.power: Draws a map of the building you're in

spellstones.name: Abyssal Breath Spellstone
spellstones.power: Lets you and everyone with you breathe underwater

spellstones.name: Pelagic Flight Spellstone
spellstones.power: Lets you fly through the water at great speed

spellstones.name: Rust Spellstone
spellstones.power: Rots metal locks and rival base defences

spellstones.name: Spark Spellstone
spellstones.power: Powers old machines and doors

spellstones.name: Tide Spellstone
spellstones.power: Raises or lowers water to open flooded paths

spellstones.name: Tilt Spellstone
spellstones.power: Tips a room's gravity so you can walk on walls

spellstones.name: Ward Spellstone
spellstones.power: Seals a door so only family can open it

spellstones.name: Weathervane Spellstone
spellstones.power: Changes the weather over a region

forge_tablet.name: Forgemaster's Tablet
forge_tablet.text: One blank, one pearl shell, and the anchor holds.

grotto_verse.name: Verse on the Grotto Wall
grotto_verse.text: Where the cave runs dry, the abyssal key keeps the breath of the deep.

prime_tablet.name: Clockmaker's Plate
prime_tablet.text: Two blanks and a shell, wound true, make a friend of brass.

ships_log.name: Harbourmaster's Log
ships_log.text: A single blank, drawn north, pulls every lost key home.

throne_words.name: Words on the Throne
throne_words.text: Glass of the abyss on a blank: a light for all who are lost.

title: Imagination
wand_combos: Fog and silence at once: rivals can neither see nor hear you
Reveals hidden doors and sees through the walls around you
Freezes the water and blasts enemies back in one cast
Shows fresh footprints and points to the nearest spellstone
Scatters nearby rivals and draws them away next door
